description.content: Higher-order component that manages lazy-loading for "infinite" data. This component decorates a virtual component and just-in-time prefetches rows as a user scrolls. It is intended as a convenience component; fork it if you'd like finer-grained control over data-loading.

Function responsible for rendering a virtualized component. It is passed onRowsRendered and registerChild parameters. The onRowsRendered function should be passed through to the child's onRowsRendered property. The registerChild callback should be set as the virtualized component's ref.

description.content: Callback to be invoked when more rows must be loaded. The returned Promise should be resolved once row data has finished loading. It will be used to determine when to refresh the list with the newly-loaded data. This callback may be called multiple times in reaction to a single scroll event.
